tables.name: users
tables.description:
Represents retail investors who
connect their brokerages, set configurations, and receive alerts.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the user.

columns.name: email
columns.description:
Email address of the user used
for authentication and communications.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description:
Securely hashed user
password.

columns.name: status
columns.description:
The current verification and lifecycle status of
the user account.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description:
The timestamp when the
user record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description:
The timestamp
when the user record was last updated.

tables.name: devices
tables.description:
Represents mobile devices
registered to receive transactional push notifications for a user.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the device entry.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description:
Foreign key
reference linking the device to its user owner.

columns.name: device_token
columns.description:
Unique token generated by
push providers (e.g., FCM, APNS) to direct alerts to the device.

columns.name: platform
columns.description:
The
operating system of the device (e.g., ios, android).

columns.name: status
columns.description:
The activation
status of the push channel on this device.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the device token was first registered.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description:
Timestamp when the device registration was
last modified.

tables.name: brokerage_connections
tables.description:
Tracks OAuth and sync links to external
brokerages via aggregators (e.g., Plaid, SnapTrade).

columns.name: id
columns.description:
Unique
identifier for the connection.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner of the brokerage link.

columns.name: provider_name
columns.description: The name of the aggregation gateway used (e.g., SnapTrade).

columns.name: external_account_id
columns.description:
The identifier of the user's account inside the aggregator
platform.

columns.name: encrypted_access_token
columns.description:
AES-256 encrypted read-only brokerage authorization
token.

columns.name: token_expires_at
columns.description:
The expiration timestamp of the read-only
authorization token.

columns.name: status
columns.description: The current operational state of the synchronization bridge.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description:
When the brokerage link was originally
constructed.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description:
When the connection was last
successfully verified or edited.

tables.name: holdings
tables.description:
Represents imported
stock assets linked to a user's sync session with their brokerage.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for this specific holding entry.

columns.name: brokerage_connection_id
columns.description: The originating connection that hosts the asset holdings.

columns.name: ticker_symbol
columns.description:
The US exchange ticker abbreviation of the security (e.g.,
AAPL).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: The number of shares of the ticker currently owned by the user.

columns.name: average_purchase_price
columns.description: The average original acquisition price of the asset.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Indicates if the holding is actively in the portfolio or has been liquidated.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description:
When this stock holding was first
registered during sync.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description:
When this holding was
last reconciled with external broker data.

tables.name: alert_configurations
tables.description:
Customized
monitoring profiles targeting drop limits set on active holdings.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customized trigger rule.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description:
The
user owner of the alert configuration.

columns.name: holding_id
columns.description:
The active portfolio asset
reference being tracked by this rule.

columns.name: threshold_percentage
columns.description:
The exact percent
decline from open triggering a notification (0.1 to 99.9).

columns.name: notification_preferences
columns.description:
Configuration metadata detailing transmission
rules and payload flags.

columns.name: status
columns.description:
The
scanning configuration state (active, paused, or archived).

columns.name: last_triggered_at
columns.description:
The timestamp indicating when the threshold breach rule was last
triggered. Used for debouncing and cool-down resets.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the alert profile was established.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: When the rule details were last altered.

tables.name: alert_triggers
tables.description:
Maintains structural logging of individual drop detections and
push dispatch attempts.

columns.name: id
columns.description:
Unique identifier of the alert
instance log.

columns.name: alert_configuration_id
columns.description:
The
trigger specifications that sourced this alert action.

columns.name: triggered_price
columns.description: The actual market tick price that caused the breach detection.

columns.name: daily_open_price
columns.description: The security's opening market trade price on the trading day of trigger.

columns.name: calculated_drop_percentage
columns.description:
The exact percent decline computed during market
evaluation.

columns.name: status
columns.description:
The logical transmission states of the push
delivery workflow.

columns.name: triggered_at
columns.description:
The exact database
timestamp indicating initial breach detection.

columns.name: delivered_at
columns.description:
The
gateway callback timestamp indicating successful push confirmation.

columns.name: delivery_error_message
columns.description: Detailed provider response tracking failed notifications.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description:
The creation timestamp of the trigger
transaction.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description:
The modification timestamp of
the trigger transaction.

relationships.description:
A
user can register several active devices to receive transactional push alerts.

A
user can establish multiple external brokerage connection endpoints.

A brokerage connection contains multiple stock holdings synced
from the account.

An asset holding can have multiple threshold drop
configs linked to it.

A user owns the custom alert configurations they
configure.

An alert config records multiple event
logs when thresholds are breached.

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

FOREIGN KEY
(brokerage_connection_id) REFERENCES brokerage_connections(id) ON DELETE
CASCADE

FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON
DELETE CASCADE

FOREIGN KEY (holding_id) REFERENCES holdings(id) ON DELETE
CASCADE

FOREIGN KEY (alert_configuration_id) REFERENCES alert_configurations(id) ON
DELETE CASCADE

indexes.reason:
Allows rapid retrieval of destination push tokens when an active user
alert configuration is triggered.

Speeds up user dashboard
load and backend sync query performance across a user's accounts.

Guarantees a 3NF distinct unique constraint mapping one single
ticker quantity representation per connection.

Speeds up lookups on
active assets by ticker during real-time market-wide index matches.

Ensures real-time stream monitor queries only fetch
scanning-active rules matching ticker changes.

Optimizes
speed of audit logs retrieval inside historical notification lists.

domain_events.name: BrokerageConnectedEvent
domain_events.trigger:
Fires upon
successful completion of OAuth account links using aggregation software.

domain_events.name: HoldingLiquidatedEvent
domain_events.trigger:
Fires when quantity of a synced holding returns 0, indicating the
asset was fully sold.

domain_events.name: AlertConfigurationArchivedEvent
domain_events.trigger:
Fires automatically when an
active alert rule is archived due to a holding being liquidated.

domain_events.name: MarketDropDetectedEvent
domain_events.trigger:
Fires within sub-seconds of
a streaming tick drop breaching active alert configuration parameters.

domain_events.name: ConnectionReauthRequestedEvent
domain_events.trigger:
Fires during sync attempts if
token validation returns expired credentials.
